title: Fifthbell sitemap input
description: One sitemap file as the CMS sends it (fifthbell/cronkite#155): the story URLs of one month, or the site's pages. At least one entry and at most 4,000: the most that can never pass the sitemaps.org 50 MB (50,000,000 bytes) uncompressed limit, whatever the entries hold (a loc of 2,048 characters that Handlebars escapes to 6 bytes each, plus markup, is under 12,500 bytes an entry, and 4,000 of them are under 50,000,000). The sitemaps.org limit of 50,000 URLs is therefore not reachable in one file: the producer splits larger sets across files, and keeps the single host of every loc. Each loc is an absolute https URL and each lastmod the story's real updatedAt. Keys Brokaw does not know are ignored.

layout.description: Optional: the publish request names the renderable. When present it must be this renderable's name. A producer whose gateway validates any document that has a layout as a canonical document leaves it out.

url.description: An absolute https URL with no whitespace or control character, at most 2,048 characters (the sitemaps.org limit).

lastmod.description: A W3C date (YYYY-MM-DD) or date-time with a time zone.
